edition: RP-001 v1.0, Standard MIDI Files Specification 96-1-4
name: Standard MIDI Files Specification
statement: The issuer's page for the Standard MIDI Files Specification (RP-001_v1-0_Standard_MIDI_Files_Specification_96-1-4.pdf), the file format that carries MIDI 1.0 messages: an MThd header chunk (format, track count, division) and MTrk chunks of delta-timed events. The PDF itself needs a midi.org login. Index row I06.
